audit.why: 50.86% over 2861 games — EVEN 5.5/10 is honest. Lane is a tracking contest early and Ahri's from 6 on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content and packet read Skill x4 then Ahri x3. whys[4] and content 'mid' also said level 6 favours Annie while win[4] said Ahri.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] are the same row; whys[N] must agree with win[N].
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].side -> Ahri; whys[4] and 'mid' rewritten to the Ahri side without losing the Tibbers warning.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page named only Summon: Tibbers — Pyromania, Disintegrate, Incinerate and Molten Shield never appeared. Molten Shield's burst absorption and damage-return were absent entirely, and the range gap that defines the lane was never stated.
audit.why: Annie's longest offensive reach is Molten Shield at 800 and her damage sits at 625/600/600; your orb is 970 and Charm is 975. Molten Shield is 10s, shields, speeds her up and damages anyone who hits her. Disintegrate refunds its mana on a kill, so Pyromania stacks for free off the wave.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[0].why, phases[2].why, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.carry, report[5].t, dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to check 'its cooldown' for a passive that has no cooldown.
audit.why: Pyromania is a four-cast counter with a visible glow, not a timer. The countable cooldowns are Disintegrate 4s, Incinerate 7s, Molten Shield 10s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now say count her casts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tibbers persisting as a burning aura after the cast was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot text: Tibbers attacks and burns enemies who stand near him — the ult is a zone that outlives its impact.

edits.before: Q both ways through the wave on his last-hits — the true-damage return is most of your early poke.
edits.after: Everything Annie has reaches 625 or less; your orb reaches 970 — poke from outside and she cannot answer.

edits.before: Charm online — the lane's first kill threat. Hold it for his step-up, not for prayer-range poke.
edits.after: Charm online at 975 — she must walk to 600 to cast, so charm the step-up, not the standstill.

edits.before: Annie wins by landing Summon: Tibbers, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Annie wins by banking four casts for Pyromania, stunning you at 600 range, and dropping Tibbers on top of it.

edits.before: - Annie Summon: Tibbers: matchup-defining — Flash-Tibbers off a stocked passive stun is her whole threat — watch the glow under her feet. Check it before every step-up. - R Spirit Rush (last dash) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Pyromania is a four-cast counter, not a timer — the glow under her feet is the only real cooldown here. - Disintegrate is 4s and refunds its mana on a kill, so she stacks the stun free off the wave. - Molten Shield is 10s and eats your burst; bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Carry through picks — a landed charm is a won fight, and your dashes manufacture charm angles no one wards against.
edits.after: Carry by out-ranging her: a 970 orb against a 625 Disintegrate means every trade you start is one she cannot finish.

edits.before: Track Annie’s Summon: Tibbers: Flash-Tibbers off a stocked passive stun is her whole threat — watch the glow under her feet. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Pyromania stuns with her next offensive spell after four casts, and Disintegrate refunds mana on a kill — she charges it on minions for free, so count her casts, not her cooldowns.

edits.before: Q through his last-hit so both hits land, W if he eats the return, and walk — repeat until the charm window is lethal instead of optimistic.
edits.after: Molten Shield is 10s and burns whoever strikes her — bait it out on the wave, then charm her at 975 and burst the unshielded body.

edits.before: Annie wastes Summon: Tibbers — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Tibbers burns everything standing near him — dash clear of his aura.

edits.before: That is Annie’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Her stun is stacked or it is not — trading blind into a glowing Annie is her whole plan.

edits.before: Charming on cooldown for chip damage and then facing his real engage with nothing — the charm is the matchup, not the poke.
edits.after: Your passive heals off every ninth minion — bank the full clear before stepping inside her 600-range cone, not after.

edits.before: Level 6 favors Annie — Tibbers plus a proc'd stun is close to a guaranteed all-in kill
edits.after: Level 6 turns yours — Spirit Rush's dashes leave her 600-range combo nothing to hit

edits.before: By level 6 Tibbers plus a proc'd stun swings hard in Annie's favor if you're caught out, giving her the clearest kill window of the whole laning phase, though your kit starts to pull ahead again once items come online.
edits.after: By level 6 the lane turns: Tibbers off a stacked Pyromania still kills you if you get caught inside 600 range, but Spirit Rush's three dashes mean she has to catch you first, and she owns nothing that closes that gap.

edits.before: Bait a bad trade before the stun procs
edits.after: Refund Disintegrate on minions to stack the stun free

notes: The packet's only listed defect — never naming Pyromania, Disintegrate, Incinerate or Molten Shield — is now fixed on the full layer; all four appear with their real cooldowns. The substantive correction is that the page told the reader to 'check the cooldown' of Pyromania, which is a four-cast counter with no cooldown at all, and that Disintegrate refunds its mana on a minion kill so she charges it for free. whys[4] and content 'mid' both declared level 6 an Annie window while the level chart said Ahri; I moved them to the chart's side and kept the Tibbers threat as the caveat rather than deleting it. tradeGood/tradeBad and their copies in breakdown.trading and report[3].t are still templated and refer to Annie as 'he' — I had no same-length grounded replacement and left them.
